entries.value: a burn scar across two knuckles, from a kettle she does not explain
a chipped front tooth she covers when she laughs
silver streaks in dark hair, early
a birthmark shaped like a comma below her ear
one shoulder set lower from an old fall
calluses in the shape of a pen
a tattoo she keeps covered at work
a limp that only shows when she is tired
freckles burned into a pattern by years of the same sun
a voice that goes hoarse on the last word of a sentence
two fingers that never straighten all the way
a scar through one eyebrow from a door she was pushed through
